scripts.format: tish-format examples packages cli scripts 2>/dev/null || npx --yes @tishlang/tish-format examples packages cli
scripts.format:check: tish-format --check examples packages cli 2>/dev/null || npx --yes @tishlang/tish-format --check examples packages cli
scripts.lint:tish: tish-lint examples packages cli 2>/dev/null || npx --yes @tishlang/tish-lint examples packages cli
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt -p tish_desktop -- --check && cargo clippy -p tish_desktop -- -D warnings
scripts.example:basic: npm --prefix examples/basic install && npm --prefix examples/basic run dev
scripts.example:basic:rebuild: npm --prefix examples/basic install && npm --prefix examples/basic run dev -- --rebuild
scripts.example:file-browser: npm --prefix examples/file-browser install && npm --prefix examples/file-browser run dev
scripts.example:file-browser:rebuild: npm --prefix examples/file-browser install && npm --prefix examples/file-browser run dev -- --rebuild
scripts.example:native-chrome: npm --prefix examples/native-chrome install && npm --prefix examples/native-chrome run dev
scripts.example:native-chrome:rebuild: npm --prefix examples/native-chrome install && npm --prefix examples/native-chrome run dev -- --rebuild
scripts.build:basic: npm --prefix examples/basic install && npm --prefix examples/basic run build:ui && npm --prefix examples/basic run build:shell
scripts.build:file-browser: npm --prefix examples/file-browser install && npm --prefix examples/file-browser run build:ui && npm --prefix examples/file-browser run build:shell
scripts.build:native-chrome: npm --prefix examples/native-chrome install && npm --prefix examples/native-chrome run build:ui && npm --prefix examples/native-chrome run build:shell
